name: 12075 · Ghent, NY
findings: ZIP 12075 (Ghent) has 17 nonprofit organizations. 9 of them (53%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 8 organizations.
Arts and cultural organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (40% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 12075 (Ghent) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
44% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 12075 (Ghent) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 3.0 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 8 organizations here; 47% of all organizations here have no identified type.
